title: Talent & Events Intern
summary: Work directly alongside the founder on live music production — from artist conversations to event-day execution. The goal over time is to develop you into someone who can run the show floor independently.
highlights: Plan and execute live music events from concept through close-out
Coordinate contractor logistics, run-of-show, and vendor communications
Support artist and DJ coordination as an on-site point of contact
Represent LUPFR on the event floor, problem-solving in real time

title: Marketing & Strategy Intern
summary: Help own and evolve the LUPFR brand across all public-facing channels — content, community, and creative on the front end; strategy, PR support, and B2B communications on the back end.
highlights: Manage day-to-day content and community on Instagram and TikTok
Run and grow email and SMS marketing with Klaviyo
Support PR efforts — press outreach, media lists, coverage tracking
Track performance analytics and report on what's working
